name: Cordless Phone Display
summary: Unbranded cordless landline handset on a charging base, with a small retail plinth and blank price-card holder.
description: Original static retail display for store S17: rear-leaning handset with twelve geometric number keys, navigation control, small blank sage LCD, earpiece slots, microphone details and antenna stub; charging cradle with page button, indicator and rear socket details; low plinth and empty price-card holder.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.
accuracy_notes: Static illustrative visual prop; no telephone, wireless, charging or price functionality. Screen and price card are blank. Physical Android/iOS, WebKit and complete mall performance NOT TESTED.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials. No external assets.
